_notes: P1-R01 (#89) authoritative inventory + classification of existing research-orchestration core suites. Inventoried from research-orchestration/test/*.test.mjs on the frozen planning source master @ 5fd9fe00135e3f182cd106cf7b89b15246943d49. This manifest is the single source of truth for which research suites CI must execute; the runner (scripts/run-classified-research-suites.mjs) enforces it. Each suite has exactly one category. Future repair tickets register their own RED->GREEN suites here (R01 owns only the registration path). Per-suite `requires` flags execution needs the runner must honor: workingDirectory (repo-relative cwd contract; never a machine-specific absolute path), npmInstall (set true only if a suite triggers real embedding and needs @xenova/transformers — currently NONE, because embedding-provider.mjs lazy-imports it only on real model load and no current suite does). live-gated / private-canonical suites are NOT executed in ordinary PR CI; they are reported as NOT_RUN so their absence is never counted as offline success.

P2A-T10 (#122): final-artifact visibility of the targeted-requery gap terminals (Seam S10 / F.4 + G.5 + H-8; Spec §13, §20-9, §20-11). SCOPE AUDIT before writing: the final artifact ALREADY has a `gap` field, but it is a DIFFERENT object - { missingAnalyzed, missingMapped } is SOURCE-ANALYSIS COVERAGE (which selected sources were never mapped/analyzed, a T15 completeness concern), not a research gap. cross-source-synthesis`unresolved` is also a different object - it is CLAIM-level (sourceClaimId, no gapId, no resolutionBasis). T08 targeted-requery-resolution.json carried the real terminals but was referenced ONLY by targeted-requery-subphase.mjs and never by coverage-final-integration.mjs, so the terminal set genuinely did not reach the product. This suite therefore fills a real gap and does NOT re-implement terminal judgment: every terminal asserted here is produced by T08 own classifyGapTerminal()/recordResolution() and only RENDERED by T10. COVERS AC1-AC4: (A) terminal visibility matrix - RESOLVED / UNRESOLVED / EXHAUSTED_WITHIN_BUDGET each appear per-gap with their real basis, and the three statuses present are exactly T08 closed terminal set; (B) lineage round-trip - gapId -> targetedActionId -> query -> providerId/capability -> resultArtifact, joined by value from T06 action record + T08 evaluatedActionIds, with a symmetric back-check that the id resolves to a real record; (C) STOP preservation - T08 finalizeGapsOnRunStop() output stays fully visible after a run-level RUN_BUDGET_STOP, and a never-authorized gap reads UNRESOLVED not exhausted; (D) budget exhaustion renders EXHAUSTED_WITHIN_BUDGET and never SATURATED - SATURATED survives only as a BASIS on an UNRESOLVED gap, which is the honest direction; (E) path safety - T06 already refuses an absolute artifactRel, and T10 independently refuses a tampered record whose committed ref is absolute, so no machine path can reach the product; (F) resolved/unresolved separation - a hand-forged RESOLVED with a non-producible basis, a RESOLVED carrying NONE_REGISTERED, and a status of SATURATED are each refused (three independent fences: set membership, T08 isAllowedTerminalTriple consumed not copied, and the terminal-set check); (G) additive compatibility - the pre-existing source-analysis `gap` field is byte-identical after attach, the input object is not mutated, and an empty targeted path yields an empty block rather than a missing key. HONEST LIMITS: this is a focused unit suite over the T10 surface with real T08/T06 artifacts - it does NOT claim an end-to-end finalizeResearchCoverage run; and it does not exercise the sub-clause providerFailuresThisRound.length === 0 in the saturation precondition, which a round-4 reviewer showed has NO covering suite anywhere in the repo (that gap belongs to T07/T15, not this ticket). Fully offline; no network, no model.

P2A-T11 (#123): trust-boundary EXECUTABLE guard suite (SEAM F.3 / task §8; not prose acceptance). Mechanical ENUMERATION of the assertArtifactSafe call surface (no call site left unclassified; the trust-set module set asserted by module, not by line, so contract-neutral line drift does not fail); the four frozen F.3 call sites proven by BEHAVIOUR (a trust set relaxes only the provider-content lens, never the plan lens; a plan-UNSAFE string stays rejected even when listed; trust is exact-match, so unsafe near-misses inherit nothing); the single-lens plannedQueryVariants gate proven to reject plan-unsafe strings on a real createInitialCoverageState fixture; the T09 augmented-pool walk proven behaviourally (a provider-unsafe targeted string is refused at the T04 gate and reaches neither the pool nor the authorized set) PLUS a structural guard that NO trust set in lib/ derives its elements from a targeted surface; the dual-lens gate proven to be the intersection and to degrade visibly under a single-lens OR; UNCLASSIFIED fail-closed; free-form queryText refused in the MVP with a plan-owned positive control so the refusal is specific; F.5 anchoring (anchored reader only, no unanchored loader import, no sidecar/receipt second credential in code). Every behavioural guard carries a counterexample that must genuinely fail, and the non-vacuity of the A3/C3/D/E guards was established by bounded mutation (trust-as-bypass, trusted-pool-queries, new trust-set call site, AND->OR, free-form authorization) with each mutation reverted. Fully offline; no network, no model.

P2A-T13 (#125): STOP / budget non-interference counterexample matrix (Seam H.1-H.8 + C1-C12; task §9). Scope was narrowed by a START-GATE EVIDENCE AUDIT to ONLY_MISSING_COUNTEREXAMPLES; this suite adds only what was genuinely missing and does NOT re-define identity / dedupe / replay. CORRECTION to that audit's conclusion, found by CODE review at 621b534 and re-verified by mutation: the audit recorded H-1..H-8 and C1..C12 as 'already covered across T04/T05/T06/T07/T08/T09/T11', and that blanket claim was FALSE for H-5. H-5 'targeted must not MANUFACTURE SATURATED' was covered by NOTHING - swapping the saturation precondition denominator at lib/retrieval-round-controller.mjs:350 from plannedCoverageCount to attemptsBudgetCount leaves all 18 relevant suites green, so the FAIL_CLOSED merge-gate condition at P2_ARI_108_TICKET_DECOMPOSITION_V1.md:690-691 was unenforced. Case C11b now pins the manufacture direction and C11 pins the converse (must not BLOCK a plan-earned saturation); H-1..H-4 and H-6..H-8 remain covered by the other suites. (1) H-4 field-level proof that targeted attempts leave the NAMED coverageState.retrieval.retrievalRounds field untouched - the pre-existing T07 C2 assertion covered only roundIndex / nextRoundIndex / shouldStop, never the contract-named counter field; the real write path (applyRoundEvaluationToCoverageState -> updateRetrievalCoverage, retrievalRounds = roundIndex) was probed before asserting, never assumed. (2) SATURATION_SEMANTICS_DISCLAIMER complete frozen literal: exact key set ['meaning','nonGoals'], the full meaning sentence verbatim, exactly 5 nonGoals each byte-identical AND order-checked, plus Object.isFrozen - replacing the T07 E2 symbol-grep and the retrieval-round-controller self-comparison that both pass even when the text changes. (3) The C1-C12 matrix collapsed into ONE runnable gate: each counterexample drives a real production function and asserts the verdict that guard must return. Most are fail-closed (a violating input must be REFUSED), but the required direction differs per case and is documented in each case's own comment - C4 replays a durably COMMITTED action and must be REUSED (clean commit, not a crash), C5 covers the crash windows either side of the commit point and must yield exactly one safe re-run. Read this as 'twelve ordered guard verdicts', NOT as 'twelve refusals'. Cases: C1 dedupe, C2 unresolvable parent, C3 provider-unsafe string, C4 committed replay, C5 pre-commit crash re-run, C6 duplicate-only, C7 same-side, C8 NONE_REGISTERED, C9 budget stop, C10 provider failure, C11 saturation with targeted, C12 identity replay conflict. Non-vacuity was proved by mutation, not asserted: neutering the whole gate body to `return;`, weakening the pinned meaning, shortening retrievalRounds, flipping individual expected verdicts, and mutating the production write path to `roundIndex + targeted.executed` each turn the suite RED. C12 exercises the ROOT guard decideTargetedReplay, not the T09 subphase integration route, and says so in-file. Fully offline; no network, no model.
